summary: Iteration 216ah — Sprint A (G1, G2, G3, G4, G8) testing complete. CRITICAL BUG FIXED: 'Cannot access headers before initialization' in MembershipsConsole.js (variable hoisting issue). Backend: 15/15 tests passed. All Sprint A features verified: G1 onboarding checklist (5 steps, dismiss, progress), G2 Studio Builder '+ New class' button with ClassTemplateEditor, G3 Edit class tab in ClassActionDrawer, G4 operator booking endpoint with validation, G8 optimistic drag/drop (no page jump).

bugs_fixed.issue: ReferenceError: Cannot access 'headers' before initialization - variable hoisting issue where 'headers' was used in useEffect before being defined
bugs_fixed.fix: Moved token and headers declarations before the useEffect that uses them (lines 78-79)

Backend bookings.py: operator_book_member endpoint validates empty list (400), >10 members (400), unknown member (404), unknown occurrence (404), silent dedupe on retry
seed_data_creation: Test class templates created during pytest run (cleaned up by fixtures). Bob's org has 42 members, 1 class template, 2 plans.

rca_of_the_issue.bug: MembershipsConsole.js crashed with 'Cannot access headers before initialization'
rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: JavaScript const/let hoisting - the 'headers' variable was used in a useEffect on line 86 but defined on line 98. Unlike 'var', const/let are not hoisted to the top of the function scope.
reproduction_steps: 2. Page crashes with ReferenceError in MembershipsConsoleInner
rca_of_the_issue.fix_applied: Moved 'const token = localStorage.getItem("token")' and 'const headers = useMemo(...)' declarations to lines 78-79, before the useEffect that uses them
rca_of_the_issue.verification: After fix, Memberships console loads successfully and all features work
